title: tribulus solandri
intro: Tribulus solandri, commonly known as the Chinese caulis or Yang shan, is a plant species in the family Capparaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include improving cardiovascular health, boosting immune function, and alleviating symptoms of menopause and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Tribulus solandri are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
